Container.Name: qbt-rules
Container.Overview:
Rules engine for qBittorrent. Write declarative YAML rules that tag, categorise, pause, throttle, force-seed or delete torrents based on their state, files, trackers, peers and more, triggered by qBittorrent events, a schedule, or an HTTP call.
[b]Starts in dry-run mode:[/b] it only logs what it would do until you set Dry run to false.
Your rules live in rules.yml in the State folder, which must be writable: the dashboard's rules editor saves it. Nothing is created on first start, so copy in your rules.yml or write one in the editor. config.yaml in the Config folder is optional (every setting is also a variable). The dashboard on the WebUI port shows jobs and rules (log in with the API key).
[b]qBittorrent hook[/b] (Tools, Options, Downloads, Run external program on torrent added): docker exec qbt-rules qbt-rules execute --context torrent-imported --hash "%I" (use --context download-finished on torrent finished). If qBittorrent runs in a container without Docker access, call the HTTP API with curl instead: see the Contexts wiki page.
[b]Upgrading from 0.10.x:[/b] /config is no longer read. Copy, don't move, your files from the old appdata folder: config.yml to etc/config.yaml (with a few edits), rules.yml and qbt-rules.db to state/, then remove the old /config path. The qBittorrent hook line above is new too. Read https://github.com/andronics/qbt-rules/wiki/Upgrading-to-0.11 first.
Documentation: https://github.com/andronics/qbt-rules/wiki
Container.Changes: ### qbt-rules 0.11 - Two paths replace /config: Config (/etc/qbt-rules, config.yaml, read-only) and State (/var/lib/qbt-rules, rules.yml and the job database, writable). Copy your files across before updating: https://github.com/andronics/qbt-rules/wiki/Upgrading-to-0.11 - New qBittorrent hook line: docker exec qbt-rules qbt-rules execute --context torrent-imported --hash "%I" - The image is pinned to the 0.11 series (:0.11): 0.11.x fixes arrive automatically; a later breaking release needs this template updated.
Container.Requires: qBittorrent with its Web UI enabled, reachable from this container.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Dashboard and HTTP API (e.g. for qBittorrent's 'Run external program' webhook).

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: config.yaml (optional: every setting is also a variable). Read-only is fine.

Config.Name: State
Config.Description: rules.yml, the job database and the rules editor's history. Must be writable; the container gives it to PUID:PGID on start.

Config.Name: qBittorrent URL
Config.Description: qBittorrent Web UI address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Secret for the HTTP API and dashboard login. Use a long random string.

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: true: only log what rules would do. Set to false once you've reviewed rules.yml.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG logs every rule evaluation. The log goes to the container log (Docker tab, Logs).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container runs as; owns the State folder.
